name: byjg/gluo-laravel
description: Gluo for Laravel — pluggable connectors that adapt the ByJG components to Laravel. Install only the components you need; each connector activates itself. Ships OpenAPI contract testing and runtime validation on top of byjg/swagger-test.

suggest.byjg/statemachine: Enables the `statemachine` connector: finite state machines declared as configuration and bound to your Eloquent models.
suggest.byjg/swagger-test: Enables the `openapi` connector: OpenAPI contract testing and runtime request/response validation.
